name: SpongeBob in Run For The Krusty Krab
storyline: Nothing stands between SpongeBob and the Krusty Krab! Help him avoid the obstacles and get to work!
summary: Dash, dodge, and don’t be late for work! Help SpongeBob sprint to the Krusty Krab, hop over crazy obstacles, and survive the silliness of Bikini Bottom in this fast, goofy, jellyfish-powered run!
